parts.name: scope guard & knowledge check
parts.about: `story_guards.after_chapter` after each approved chapter: Akọwe's own checks (no AI) list a new name late in the book (`scope_guard`, from ~70 % of the book) and a character who knows a fact too early / a hidden fact on the page before its chapter (`knowledge_grid.check`); ONE independent AI confirms them with an exact quote (`guard_check`), ONE targeted fix (`guard_rewrite`) goes through the review again; else they are listed. Never holds up the book.

parts.name: voice test
parts.about: `voice_test.py`: before chapters 3, 6 … and in the middle of the book Akọwe measures each speaker's lines on the page (no AI); in the middle and at the end ONE blind speaker test (`voice_blind`: masked lines → who said it?) by an AI that did not write the book; pairs that read alike go into the next chapters' brief and the report. Never holds up the book.

parts.name: key scenes written twice
parts.about: `key_scenes.after_draft`: for the key chapters (climax / setback of the story shape, else the last chapter; never chapter 1; chapters of 200–7 000 words) the writer writes a second version (`key_scene_version`), up to two independent judges pick head to head (`pairwise.pick`, `pairwise`), the winner is kept (Akọwe's checks must accept it). Never holds up the book.

parts.name: ending writer
parts.about: `ending_writer.py` (no AI call of its own): the last chapter (and the story shape's climax chapter) gets an ending brief — the checklist of payoffs, plot obligations, the main character's change, the book's question and the AI-ending habits to avoid — in the writer's brief (`C02`) and in that chapter's review (`review`); every later chapter gets the facts to cite.

parts.name: keep briefs
parts.about: `keep_brief.py` (no AI call of its own): every AI rewrite of a chapter (review fix `fix`, checks repair, editor / planned / ending rewrites) is told the chapter's strongest lines (KEEP); a fix that drops one is refused (KEEP_LOST), a fix that changes only punctuation is refused and ends the fixing (FIX_COSMETIC), a kept editor rewrite without gain ends the editor's rounds.

parts.name: continuity checkpoints
parts.about: `checkpoints.run_due`: every N chapters (default 5), at act ends and after the last chapter an AI reads the chapters in full (`checkpoint`; with two AIs also each new chapter by all of them) and lists inconsistencies with exact quotes; small safe fixes are applied and reviewed again; a problem without a safe fix pauses the run ONCE (CHECKPOINT_WAITING, ▶ Continue goes on).

parts.name: planned (planned details on the page)
parts.about: Inside each chapter after the editor (`_planned_pass`): did the plan reach the page? Deterministic check plus one AI check (`planned`), missing items go to the writer once (`planned_rewrite`), the fix is kept only if it is reviewed and fewer items are missing. Then the `planned` step checks the whole book (a report: never holds up the book).
